summary: Kaggle/prototype data remain the deployed questionnaire model for the main Alzheimer-class probability. NACC public-questionnaire longitudinal analysis is integrated as a supplementary backend evidence source. The website reports the two outputs separately and does not fuse them into a single clinical probability; external clinical validation remains incomplete.

routes.label: Kaggle prototype model
routes.probability_definition: Internally calibrated probability of membership in the dataset's Alzheimer diagnosis class conditional on the submitted questionnaire.
routes.interpretation_limit: Prototype class-estimation route; not a clinical diagnosis or future-onset forecast.

routes.label: NACC public-questionnaire backend evidence
routes.target: Later dementia conversion from baseline information
routes.probability_definition: Platt-calibrated probability that the user's input pattern resembles NACC baseline participants who later converted to dementia.
routes.interpretation_limit: Integrated as supplementary backend evidence; not fused with the Kaggle score, not externally validated and not a clinical forecast.
